subject: Speaker Proposal - AI Security Best Practices
body:
Dear Conference Organizers,

I'm writing to submit a speaker proposal for your upcoming Tech Summit 2026.

Proposed Topic: "AI Security Best Practices: Protecting Your Models from Adversarial Attacks"

Session Details:
- Duration: 45 minutes
- Format: Presentation with Q&A
- Target Audience: Developers and Security Professionals
- Level: Intermediate to Advanced

About Me:
- 5+ years in AI security research
- Published papers on adversarial machine learning
- Experience with enterprise security implementations

I believe this topic would be valuable for your attendees. Please let me know if you need any additional information.

Best regards,
You
